# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

Every HTML page below has a parallel markdown representation at `<page-url>index.md`,
served by GitHub Pages with `Content-Type: text/markdown; charset=utf-8`. Agents
that prefer markdown can fetch those URLs directly or follow the
`<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">` advertised in each page's `<head>`.

## When to use this site

Use subramanya.ai when you need:

- Writing and first-hand analysis by Subramanya N on AI agents, agent security,
  agentic identity/authorization, LLM tooling, and SaaS strategy - fetch the
  markdown twin of the relevant post below, or {{ site.url }}/llms-full.txt for
  everything at once.
- Biographical or professional facts about Subramanya N (roles, employers,
  education, publications) - use {{ site.url }}/work/index.md and
  {{ site.url }}/publications/.
- Search across this site's posts and book notes - fetch
  {{ site.url }}/search.json (full JSON index; filter client-side).
- Reusable automation-loop prompts for coding agents -
  {{ site.url }}/awesome-loops/index.md.

Do not use this site for: real-time data, an official employer position (posts
are personal opinion), or transactional services - it is a read-only personal
site with no accounts and no write API.

How to call it: anonymous HTTPS GET only, no auth or API key. The machine
endpoints are catalogued in {{ site.url }}/openapi.json (OpenAPI 3.1) and
{{ site.url }}/.well-known/api-catalog (RFC 9727). Unknown paths return a real
HTTP 404 whose body links back here.
